capabilities: Show a floating toolbar on text selection
Manage comment threads in a sidebar
Format blocks from a left-side hover menu
Sync local comments to Feishu / Lark documents
disambiguation: Not only highlighting: it also manages comment threads and block-level formatting menus.
extras: Local-first; comments and marks are kept in .obsidian-float-marks/ rather than the Markdown body. From 0.1.22 the plugin ID is floatmark, so existing users must reinstall and reconfigure settings.
intentEvidence: bringing a Feishu / Lark Docs-like experience to local notes
motivation: To bring a Feishu / Lark Docs-like experience to local notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mark up text with colored highlights or hold comment discussions anchored to passages.

relations.evidence: bringing a Feishu / Lark Docs-like experience to local notes
You only need the sync plugin when you want to push local comments to Feishu / Lark

summary: Adds Feishu-style floating toolbars, colored inline highlights, and sidebar comment threads stored in sidecar files.
